title: Under the Zariskian section conditions of Gabber, sections of an etale sheaf over X agree with sections over the closed subscheme Z
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma is Gabber's h^0 comparison: under the two Zariski section conditions (1) and (2) on Z subset X, the natural map Gamma(X, F) -> Gamma(Z, i^{-1}_{small}F) is bijective for every etale sheaf F (statement lines 14974-14987). The proof has two non-formal halves (proof lines 14989-15069): injectivity is a stalk computation in which the sheaf condition on the etale covering U -> U_0 gives injectivity of F(U_0) -> F(U), and surjectivity requires producing the etale local descriptions of t, refining the coproduct of the U_j to a finite surjective cover X' -> X, lifting the pullback t' by assumption (2), and descending along X' x_X X' via the finite-descent remark. H2: two explicit constructions with a finite cover and a descent step, all written out by the author.
